Tensions continue to rise in Galkayo following the reported interception and blockade of a convoy of eight PSF vehicles by Puntland authorities in Laag Bari region. The incident has reportedly heightened tensions around the PSF base in Galkio, while additional Puntland military vehicles have been observed entering the city, indicating an elevated security posture. The PSF has publicly stated that it has joined itself with the Somali National Army (SNA). According to well-informed sources, the risk of renewed armed confrontation has increased, with both sides reportedly maintaining a high state of readiness. While no direct clashes have been reported at the time of writing, the security environment remains highly volatile and could deteriorate rapidly without de-escalation. The developments revive memories of the December 2021 confrontation, when three days of intense fighting between Puntland forces and the PSF ended after Puntland President Said Abdullahi Deni announced a halt to military operations.
